title: If Pluto Nash and Super Sam had a baby in the web, the prompt went like this
author: One_Low8664
selftext:
Build a first-person survival shooter mixing Serious Sam’s monster chaos with Pluto Nash’s ridiculous lunar nightlife. Invent a name and give it swagger.

Make outrageous weapons, fast movement and chain reactions the core: inflate monsters, vacuum them up and fire them back.

Use chunky retro 3D, pixelated textures, oversized guns and neon sci-fi comic art, backed by space-funk and hip-hop.

Build with JavaScript or TypeScript and Three.js, with intuitive desktop/mobile controls, punchy feedback and quick retries.  
  
You could play it here, better on PC for sure: [https://bug.games/games/moonwalk-of-shame](https://bug.games/games/moonwalk-of-shame)
